newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-LEVERKUSEN STAY IN TITLE RACE WITH 3-1 WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEVERKUSEN STAY IN TITLE RACE WITH 3-1 WIN.

text.p: Bayer Leverkusen kept up their challenge in the tight German league title race when they beat highly-placed Karlsruhe 3-1 on Friday.

Goals from Ulf Kirsten, Dutchman Erik Meijer and Brazilian Paulo Sergio in the 22nd, 66th and 90th minutes respectively helped Leverkusen leapfrog champions Borussia Dortmund into second place in the Bundesliga.
Leverkusen, who just avoided relegation last season, are now two points behind leaders Bayern Munich who meet Cologne at home on Saturday and one ahead of Dortmund who visit lowly Duisburg.
Arminia Bielefeld drew 1-1 at home with Hamburg in the night's other match.
